# Diagnose a Failure

Preserve the current state. Reproduce or inspect the failure with the narrowest safe command. Record exact error, trigger, environment, dependency versions, expected behavior, observed behavior, and evidence. Trace through configuration, boundary, code path, telemetry, and recovery behavior. Form hypotheses, test them one at a time, and add a regression test. Do not claim root cause from correlation alone.
